intro_body: There are so many ways to help bring theater and community to the Bay Area and beyond! You can [donate today](https://pyt.secure.nonprofitsoapbox.com/donate), set up [corporate sponsorship](#corporate), or [sponsor a show, a season, a class or a camp](/ways-to-support#sponsor).
matching_note: Many employers match charitable gifts dollar-for-dollar - [search yours here to see if they do](https://pytnet.org/get-involved/matchingg).

sponsor_items.title: Show Sponsor
sponsor_items.description: Back a single production, and receive (optional) recognition, tickets, and benefits for that title.

sponsor_items.title: Season Sponsor
sponsor_items.description: Support a full season of productions across PYT, with recognition across all material, tickets and benefits.

sponsor_items.title: Sponsor Stories on Stage
sponsor_items.description: Our [Stories on Stage](https://pyt-website.pages.dev/stories-on-stage/) (SOS) program features adaptations of beloved children’s books, priced so that schools and families can afford to attend. Sponsorship is available for individual shows or the full season.
